data.narrative:
Vatn Systems is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Nelson Mills, Freddie Mills, and Geoff Manchester that has raised $76.5M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—including same-stage peers Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, applying a typical 2.0x multiplier to the $76.5M raised as a proxy baseline, implies a valuation of $153M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The substantial spread reflects heterogeneity in the defense-tech peer cohort at Series A.

Synthesizing both methods produces a triangulated range of $130M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $276M. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively on capital deployed; peer-median reflects market pricing of similar-stage operators but exhibits wide dispersion driven by Stark Defence's outlier valuation. Key uncertainties include the company's specific technology differentiation, customer traction, and defensibility relative to the peer set, which materially influence positioning within this $130M–$460M band.
